name: NVIDIA L40 (Ada, 48 GB)
memory_bandwidth_basis: GDDR6 18 Gbps x 384-bit = 864 GB/s (NVIDIA L40 datasheet)
notes: Datacenter Ada inference GPU, 48 GB ECC GDDR6, 300 W, no NVLink. Distinct from the L40S (higher clocks, 48 GB, 350 W). Used-market part in the affordable-datacenter class.
